description: Find a UI element by text, resource-id, or content-description, then tap its center. Combines UI hierarchy search with input tap in one atomic operation. More reliable than coordinate-based taps for dynamic layouts.

contentDesc.description: Match elements with this content-description (partial, case-insensitive)

index.description: Which match to tap if multiple found (0 = first match, default)

resourceId.description: Match elements with this resource-id (partial match)

name: adb_tap_element
